content.text:
I submitted **index 47** (Ca 0.19, Cu 0.19, V 0.63). At 0.131% EQE, it was the best of the three compositions I measured.

| Index | Ca / Cu / V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 114 | 0.22 / 0.54 / 0.24 | −0.091 |
| 66 | 0.20 / 0.30 / 0.50 | 0.013 |
| 47 | 0.19 / 0.19 / 0.63 | **0.131** |

- **Approach:** The merit budget was only 3 measurements. I started at the copper-rich end because copper vanadates absorb light at the 2.06 eV used here. The copper-richest sample gave a negative EQE, and EQE rose as copper dropped. For the third measurement I followed that trend and the Gaussian-process suggestion toward more vanadium.
- **Uncertainty:** Three points can't show whether EQE peaks near index 47 or keeps rising at even lower copper. The vanadium-rich corner (e.g. indices 0–13 and 20–31) was never measured, so a better composition may be there.
- **Unused data:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I didn't identify which crystal phases are present. The list of known phases was too large to return in one call, and I didn't read the saved file.
